FRENCH — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Interactive Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Speaking.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Speaking.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Speaking.

2. The French word for “book” is: (1 mark)
   A. fenêtre
   B. livre
   C. chaise
   D. porte

3. “Bonjour” is used to say: (1 mark)
   A. Good night only
   B. Excuse me
   C. Good morning / hello
   D. Thank you

4. When practising Interactive listening 1.3 Active listening 1.4 Listening for information, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   B. Copy random text without understanding Interactive listening 1.3 Active listening 1.4 Listening for information.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Interactive listening 1.3 Active listening 1.4 Listening for information.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive listening 1.3 Active listening 1.4 Listening for information.

7. When practising Interactive speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive speaking.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive speaking.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Interactive speaking.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Interactive speaking.

8. When practising Oral expression, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral expression.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Oral expression.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Oral expression.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Oral expression.

9. When practising Listening for information Vocabulary Grammar Attention, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening for information Vocabulary Grammar Attention.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for information Vocabulary Grammar Attention.
